action.command: cd /workspace && openssl pkcs12 -in config/admin.p12 -nokeys -passin pass:admin 2>&1 | grep -E 'Subject|Issuer' ; echo "exit=$?"; openssl pkcs12 -in config/demo.p12 -nokeys -passin pass:demo 2>&1 | grep -E 'Subject|Issuer'; echo "exit=$?"; ls -la config/admin.p12 config/demo.p12; openssl x509 -in config/certificates/ca.crt -noout -subject -dates 2>&1
